int thumbnail_plugin_data_get (  thumbnail_plugin *  tp,
void **  data
) 
 

lets a thumbnailer-plugin get its private data this data persists from call to call, but not from session to session and is normally used to store a pointer to memory allocated when the plugin was initialized, so it may be free()d when the plugin is unloaded

an error-code

tp the plugin
